text: What We Offer Over 50s Help getting a job, from training to getting your CV polished and applying for roles – all for free. Get help Employers and HR Become an age-friendly employer and hire from our pool of candidates. All our support is free. Get started London Boroughs Group training and professional support, to help employers and over 50s in your area, all for free. Partner with us Become a memberGet access to exclusive content by joining us as a member today. It's free!Register Get Involved Be an ally Being informed is the first step to support people over 50s Learn more Make a donation If you’d like to support WiseAge and it’s mission, you can donate to us! Donate Campaign with us Join our campaigns and have your say in consultations Support Key Resources For Over 50s We have a variety of resources available for older jobseekers, click the button below to see how we can help you. GO THERE For Employers As an Employer, it important to be aware of age-related issues, head to our “For Employers” page for more info! GO THERE For All We have many resources available for researchers & more in the age/employment sector. GO THERE Search our website Press Escape to close the search panel. The ultimate jobseeker's guide​ We have a guide available for Unemployed seniors, with all of the tips & tricks you'll need to find a job!
